speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the week. Thirty-seven shillings. That is the playing. It is not a house. I am not telling you a house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-seven. Say the other one beside it. Do not build a sum out of the pair.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Sir Edward. Twelve shillings and sixpence. It lies beside the thirty-seven. It does not go into it. Five pounds was the purse. Four shillings was the glass. The four shillings is not off the five, and it is not off the twelve and six.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I saw the purse go into his hand before the last speech. I am a witness to the order. I am not a witness to a total.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then there is no total. The coffer is not counted tonight. Two lines. Nothing written underneath for show.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, Quiney still has his pound out. I am not collecting it because a parlour was courteous.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Last Saturday's forty is already in the pouch. It is not this paper. Do not write it again to keep these numbers company.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I was not going to. That forty is entered. I am not writing a receipt twice, and I am not reopening a box that was not divided.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The three nights are not in this book. They have not been played. Expected is not received. A good purse makes a man add the Queen in his head. I will not help him do it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Queen is not in this week's ink. Sir Edward is. Thirty-seven is. They stay in their own lines.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Christmas is not this table. I am not sending the quarter's sixty anywhere tonight. I am not paying the chamber's twenty out of a reckoning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The rent has its own day. Today is not that day. I will not spend it early by saying it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Twelve and six is the share of the five pounds. I have said the purse. I am not saying a new one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No third line for a kindness, and no third line for a fear. If it was not received, it is not here.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, thirty-seven, and beside it twelve and six. I will read them once more. I will not add. Thirty-seven. Twelve and six.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The glass stays broken. Four shillings stays named, and stays out of both lines. A broken property is not a third column.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two lines. I know them. I will write them at home with both locks open, and I will not write a sum under them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Underneath is how a man lies to himself on a Saturday. There is no underneath.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The boys were thanked by name. The cart was a cart. Neither of those is money to enter twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The afternoon was Egeon, and he is inside the thirty-seven. He does not want a separate boast.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, that is the week. Say the two figures back to me, and the book can shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-seven. Twelve and six. Beside, not folded.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Beside. I heard both. I did not hear a third.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then it shuts. No Rose in it. We do not know a Rose receipt, and a rumour will not be written as one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No rumour. The two lines are the count. The rest of the night is not the company's.
